title: Contact form
description: ECL contact form: form groups with labels and help text, textarea, submit button.

components.reason: Carries the label and help block — the prerequisite for every ECL field
Email address field inside the form group
Submit — the only primary button on the page

nesting: Components 2-3 sit inside form groups (component 1 pattern); component 4 follows
validationOrder: Every field is inside an ecl-form-group with a for/id-linked label
Errors: ecl-form-group--error + ecl-text-input--error + ecl-feedback-message linked via aria-describedby
a11yNotes: Error feedback text must match the notification wording when present
agentPromptSequence: 1. Build one ecl-form-group per field with label + help block
2. Place the textarea group below the input group
3. Close with the primary submit button
4. On failure, switch groups to the error variant and link feedback messages
